description: Server/DB slice: the backfill RPC, its pgTAP test, and the generated-type entry. Self-contained and independently verifiable via `supabase test db` + `tsc`. FEAT-002 depends on this feature's src/types/db.ts edit (so the client RPC call type-checks) and on the RPC contract, so this comes first.
steps: Create supabase/migrations/20250109000001_backfill_portfolio_snapshots_rpc.sql defining public.backfill_portfolio_snapshots() exactly per design.md §1.2-§1.5. It must be `language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public`, take NO arguments, and `returns int` (rows upserted). Mirror the conventions of supabase/migrations/20250105000007_supporting_rpcs.sql and 20250105000006_place_market_order_rpc.sql.

Guards (design §1.2): v_uid := public.current_user_id(); if null raise exception 'not_authenticated'. select the paper_accounts row for v_uid; if not found raise exception 'no_account'. Both raised as bare error codes (no SQLSTATE custom), matching place_market_order.

Date bounds (design §1.3): v_today := (now() at time zone 'America/New_York')::date; v_last := v_today - 1; v_start := least(account.created_at ET date, coalesce(min filled order ET date, account created ET date)). If v_start > v_last then return 0.

Reconstruction (design §1.4): one set-based `insert ... select` over `generate_series(v_start, v_last, interval '1 day')::date` with CTEs days, fills, holdings, priced, positions_value, cash. fills groups the caller's status='filled' orders by symbol and ET fill date with signed_qty = sum(buy qty minus sell qty) and sell_total/buy_total using coalesce(o.total_cents, 0) (total_cents is NULLABLE — verified line 31 of 20250105000002_trading_ledger.sql). holdings = running sum of signed_qty for fill_date <= snap_date, `having sum(signed_qty) <> 0`. priced = correlated most-recent-bar lookup: (select qb.close_cents from quote_bars qb where qb.symbol = h.symbol and qb.bar_date <= h.snap_date order by qb.bar_date desc limit 1). positions_value = coalesce(sum(qty * coalesce(close_cents,0)),0)::bigint per day (missing bar contributes 0). cash = greatest(starting_cash_cents + sum(sell_total <= D) - sum(buy_total <= D), 0)::bigint. insert equity = cash + positions_value with on conflict (account_id, snap_date) do update set the three cents columns to excluded.*. get diagnostics v_count = row_count; return v_count.

Comments required in the migration: a top-of-function `-- DIVERGENCE` block stating the price source is quote_bars.close_cents (historical) vs snapshot_portfolios()'s live quotes.price_cents, and that row shape/column semantics still match the cron; a comment that the greatest(...,0) cash clamp is a DEFENSIVE floor (place_market_order blocks negative cash via insufficient_cash, so it never fires on RPC-produced data; it guards directly-seeded/migrated rows only); a comment that coalesce(total_cents,0) prevents a NULL filled total from propagating NULL into the not-null snapshot cents columns.

Grants (design §1.5): `revoke execute on function public.backfill_portfolio_snapshots() from public, anon;` and `grant execute on function public.backfill_portfolio_snapshots() to authenticated;`. Add no grant to portfolio_snapshots itself.

Create supabase/tests/backfill_portfolio_snapshots.test.sql mirroring supabase/tests/supporting_rpcs.test.sql and _helpers.sql usage. Open with `begin; select plan(22); create extension if not exists pgtap; \set helpers_included on; \ir _helpers.sql;` and close with `select * from finish(); rollback;`. Seed instruments/profiles/paper_accounts/orders/quote_bars as the owner (reset role, RLS bypassed); switch roles with reset role / set role authenticated|anon and set claims via tests.set_authenticated_claims / tests.clear_claims().

Seed the design §2.1 worked example for user A: starting_cash_cents 1000000, created_at well in the past (e.g. 2025-01-02); instruments AAA/BBB; filled orders at noon ET — 2025-01-03 buy AAA 10 @ total 100000, 2025-01-05 buy BBB 5 @ 50000, 2025-01-07 sell AAA 4 @ 48000; quote_bars close_cents AAA {01-03:10000, 01-04:10500, 01-08:12000}, BBB {01-06:11000, 01-08:9000}. Also seed user E (cash, no orders), user B (ownership isolation), an authenticated no-account user, and a directly-seeded single-day over-buy ledger (starting 100000, one filled BUY total 150000, no sells) for the clamp case.

Assert exactly the 22 rows from design §2.3 in order: #1-6 equity_cents on 2025-01-03..08 = 1000000/1005000/955000/1010000/1016000/1015000; #7 cash_cents on 01-07 = 898000; #8 positions_value_cents on 01-05 = 105000; #9-10 idempotency (second run: same row count, equity on 01-08 unchanged); #11 no-position user E equity = starting_cash and positions_value 0; #12 cash reconstruction != live cash (set A's live cash_cents different, assert reconstructed matches ledger); #13 clamp cash_cents = 0; #14-16 ownership (B wrote only B's rows; A's rows unchanged by B's run; authenticated-as-B sees 0 of A's rows under RLS); #17 throws_ok not_authenticated; #18 throws_ok no_account; #19 max(snap_date) for A <= today ET - 1; #20 no row for A at today ET; #21 has_function_privilege authenticated execute; #22 NOT has_function_privilege anon execute.

Modify src/types/db.ts: add `backfill_portfolio_snapshots: { Args: Record<PropertyKey, never>; Returns: number };` to the Functions block (begins ~line 955, near current_user_id / get_daily_briefing). No table-type change.
acceptance_criteria: `npx supabase test db` runs the new test with plan(22) and all 22 assertions pass (AC-1 through AC-11). If Docker is unavailable, the deferral is documented and the migration + test SQL parse cleanly.

The migration timestamp sorts strictly after 20250108000003_stress_lab_rpcs.sql and no previously applied migration file is modified (`git status --short supabase/migrations` shows only the new file).
The function is SECURITY DEFINER, set search_path = public, takes no args, returns int; execute is granted to authenticated and revoked from public/anon; portfolio_snapshots gains no write grant.
`npx tsc --noEmit` passes with the new Functions entry (AC-12).
verification: npx supabase test db   (expect the new file to report plan(22) and pass; if Docker unavailable, record deferral and confirm SQL parses)
npx tsc --noEmit        (passes with the db.ts edit)
git status --short supabase/migrations   (only the new 20250109000001 file; no edits to applied migrations)
findings:
RPC CONTRACT for FEAT-002: public.backfill_portfolio_snapshots() takes NO arguments and returns int (count of rows upserted). Call via supabase.rpc('backfill_portfolio_snapshots') with no args. Raises bare error codes 'not_authenticated' (no current_user_id) and 'no_account' (authenticated but no paper_accounts row); a brand-new account with nothing to reconstruct returns 0 (no error). Writes one portfolio_snapshots row per ET calendar day from the earlier of account.created_at ET date / first filled-order ET date, up to yesterday ET (never today ET). src/types/db.ts Functions.backfill_portfolio_snapshots = { Args: Record<PropertyKey, never>; Returns: number } was added (placed right after get_daily_briefing).

PRICE SOURCE DIVERGENCE: positions are valued from quote_bars.close_cents at the carry-forward bar (bar_date <= D), not the live quotes table the cron uses; a held symbol with no bar at/before D contributes 0. Cash is reconstructed from the ledger (starting_cash + filled sell totals - filled buy totals, clamped >= 0), NOT from paper_accounts.cash_cents. Upsert is idempotent on (account_id, snap_date).

VERIFICATION: `npx tsc --noEmit` passes with the db.ts edit. `git status --short supabase/migrations` shows only the new 20250109000001 file (no applied migration edited). pgTAP (`npx supabase test db`) was DEFERRED: the local Supabase Docker stack is not running (docker info failed; db lint/psql both need the local DB at 127.0.0.1:54322 which is down, and no standalone psql binary is installed), so a live green run could not be produced. SQL was reviewed manually against the real schemas (orders/quote_bars/paper_accounts/portfolio_snapshots/profiles columns all confirmed) and the test has exactly 22 `select is|ok|throws_ok` assertions matching plan(22). FEAT-002 or a later step with Docker up should run `npx supabase test db` to confirm the green pgTAP run.

SEED QUIRKS for the worked example (test file): orders seeded at noon ET ('...T12:00:00-05:00') so ET fill dates are unambiguous; account.created_at seeded 2025-01-02 so the series starts there. Expected equity 2025-01-03..08 = 1000000/1005000/955000/1010000/1016000/1015000. The clamp case (user C) seeds an otherwise-impossible over-buy ledger directly as owner (RLS bypassed) because place_market_order blocks negative cash.
